name: Guardian of Faith

targets.description: enemies that come within 10 feet of the guardian

summary: A spectral guardian: enemies coming within 10 ft make a Dex save, 20 Radiant (half on a success), up to 60 total.
text: A spectral guardian appears in an unoccupied space within range and stays there for the duration. Any enemy that moves to a space within 10 feet of it for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20 Radiant damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The guardian vanishes once it has dealt a total of 60 damage. Lasts 8 hours (no Concentration).
